rated_messages.input_message: Keep your mind occupied if you get an urge. Do a mental puzzle, make your next shopping list, read a book, write a poem…you might be surprised how well occupying your mind can get rid of urges.
A funny thing about people is that we tend to believe what we tell ourselves. So make sure that whatever else happens today, tell yourself "I can, and I will stick to not smoking!"
Take a minute to notice what the urge feels like in your body without smoking a cigarette. Notice what is going on. See what happens. Does the urge pass?
When you begin to crave a cig, concentrate on your reasons for not smoking. Keep a list on your phone and look at it when you feel yourself beginning to falter.
Are you feeling down because you are thinking of smoking? It's really important to be kind to yourself, and to make sure you give yourself praise too!
What inspires you most to quit smoking? Are you willing to let this urge pass without smoking for that reason?
No need to get rid of these feelings or control them with a smoke. They are not permanent.
Setting small goals when you feel unmotivated is best. Maybe a small goal for now is to breathe deeply for the next 3 minutes instead of smoking.
Instead of lighting up a cigarette, light a scented candle or burn some incense.
